title: 2024 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement:
Rohan keeps a total of \(90\) guppies in \(4\) fish tanks.

• There is \(1\) more guppy in the \(2\)nd tank than in the \(1\)st tank.

• There are \(2\) more guppies in the \(3\)rd tank than in the \(2\)nd tank.

• There are \(3\) more guppies in the \(4\)th tank than in the \(3\)rd tank.

How many guppies are in the \(4\)th tank?

solutions.text:
Let \(x\) be the number of guppies in the \(1\)st tank. Hence, there are \(x+1\) guppies in the \(2\)nd tank, \(x+3\) guppies in the \(3\)rd tank, and \(x+6\) guppies in the \(4\)th tank. We then use the fact that there are a total of \(90\) guppies in the \(4\) tanks to find \(x\): \[x + x + 1 + x + 3 + x + 6 = 90\] \[4x+10=90\] \[x=20.\]

Note that we are not yet done since we are asked for the number of guppies in the \(4\)th tank and not the \(1\)st. There are \(x+6=20+6=26\) guppies in the \(4\)th tank.

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Write each tank amount in terms of the first tank
The fourth tank has \(6\) more guppies than the first
